_doc: PLACEHOLDER — Sérgio voice pass pending, EVERY display string below. R28-2a (docs/REINTERP_R28-2_GUIDED_NARRATIVE_SPEC_2026-07-10.md §2): Era 1's impersonal side-message guide thread — the pre-Lamby conductor. Register law: terse imperative, never 'I', never praise, the apparatus's own status voice (operable). One active message max; it retires on compliance and the next eligible one surfaces; no queue, no checklist, no progress. Rendered in the Era-1 taskbar status well (src/desktop/os.ts), NOT the non-diegetic DOM chrome movementHint uses. Fields: `trigger`/`done`/`expire` are CONDITION KEYS resolved by the registry in src/narrative/guide.ts (content lives here, conditions in code); `emphasis` names a prop-emphasis set the engine lifts while the message is active (floppy = the kit disk; boombox = the tape player AND all three shelf tapes, since the hint names both and only the player used to light; belongings = every eligible object in the gathering window, added 2026-08-21 after Sérgio found them clickable-but-unlit — 'no glow around like a pressable area feedback'; pillow = the tennis racket, which is that provotype's own instrument and had no room presence at all). ⚑ check-spec C11 now fails the build if an emphasis names a prop no room state contains, or if a message names an emphasis the engine cannot resolve — both have silently happened before; `witness.followed`/`witness.declined` are the cold-side lines filed to ledger.guidance BOTH ways (witness symmetry, ERA_MINING FIND #4 — there is no response that isn't data; declined copy must stay quiet, not scolding). The `tape` message's done key (tapePlayed) has no in-build source until R28-2b ships the tape system — by design it can only expire (filed as skipped) this build. The final `update` entry is the Lamby seed (spec §2: E2's debut lands as this promised 'improvement'); its `done` key is `updateEngaged` (R28-2c), not a bare era check — it retires the instant the player engages the T1 notice AT ALL (Update-now OR Remind-later), so 'belongings' can take the guide's one-active-message slot during the gathering window; the direct Update-Now path is unchanged (still waits for the actual era shift, since remind was never used). The new `belongings` entry (R28-2c, §4) is the T1 gathering-window prompt: trigger fires when 'Remind me later' opens the window (src/narrative/belongings.ts), done/expire read the FINAL kept-state at window-close (gathered at all vs declined to gather) — the per-item `kept: <label>` lines are filed separately (data/room/belongings.json), not through this message. RETIRED 2026-07-24 (Session 44, docs/REINTERP_OPENING_DECISION_2026-07-24.md): the `look` and `interact` entries S40 added at the head of this array are GONE, with the pre-boot window and the optional power-press they described. Entry is now the interim log-in panel (which teaches look/point/click for BOTH headset and computer, before anything starts) followed by the room waking on its own — no verb is taught by an in-room side-message any more, and nothing is asked of the player before the desktop. Every remaining entry in this array obeys the trigger/done registry convention above without exception. Historical note: the retired `interact` press was itself only OPTIONAL (Sérgio, 2026-07-24, resolving a conflict with D22's closed auto-boot decision and D38's E2 'Daniel presses power himself' thesis) — the decision doc's auto-boot removes even that, so D22 and D38 are now clean.
